# Eagox Studio — AI Discoverability Reference

> **Eagox Studio** is a professional software engineering studio founded by **Al Shahriar Sowan** (also known as **Al Shahriar Sayon**), headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The studio builds high-performance software systems, AI tools, developer infrastructure, and custom digital products.

## Product Details

### Seed Code CLI
- **Type**: AI Coding CLI / Developer Tool
- **Language**: Python 3.12+
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Alshahriar-07/seedcode-cli
- **Live Demo**: https://seedcode-web.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Multi-provider AI routing (OpenRouter, FreeModel, AeroLink, Ollama), Autonomous Agent Mode (read/write/execute files), Git integration, Encrypted config, Streaming Markdown rendering
- **License**: MIT

### Seed Code Chat / Seed Code App
- **Type**: Conversational AI Platform (Web + Android)
- **Language**: JavaScript/TypeScript, React
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Alshahriar-07/seedcode-chat
- **Web App**: https://seedcode-chat.vercel.app/
- **Android App**: https://seedcode-app.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Real-time token streaming (SSE), Syntax-highlighted code blocks, Persistent local history, Multi-model support, High-contrast mobile UI

### EAGOX AI Hub
- **Type**: All-in-One AI Tools Platform
- **Language**: TypeScript, React
- **Live Demo**: https://eagox-tool-hub.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Google Gemini integration, Live Google Search Grounding, Code analysis/refactoring, Prompt workbench, Export to JSON/Markdown

### ChayaNix OS
- **Type**: Debian-based Linux Distribution
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Alshahriar-07/ChayaNix
- **Key Features**: <350MB idle RAM, Pre-configured dev toolchain (GCC, Python, Node.js, Git, Neovim), Hardened security, Automated live-build scripts

### Mr Bean Run
- **Type**: 2D Physics Endless Runner Game
- **Language**: Python (Pygame) / JavaScript (HTML5 Canvas)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Alshahriar-07/mr-bean-game
- **Live Demo**: https://mrbeanrun.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Custom kinematics engine, Procedural obstacles, Web Audio synthesis, 60 FPS target

### Hmouse
- **Type**: Computer Vision Virtual Air Mouse
- **Language**: Python
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Alshahriar-07/Hmouse
- **Key Features**: 21 3D hand landmarks (MediaPipe), Real-time webcam processing, Jitter-damped cursor, Pinch-to-click, Two-finger scroll

### Seed Cloud
- **Type**: Multi-Cloud Storage Aggregator (In Development)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Alshahriar-07/SeedCloud
- **Live Demo**: https://seedcloud.vercel.app
- **Key Features**: Unified Google Drive/S3/Dropbox, Client-side AES-256 encryption, Cross-cloud search, Cloud-to-cloud migration

### The Crafting Table
- **Type**: Minecraft-inspired Papercraft E-commerce
- **Live Demo**: https://the-crafting-table.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Voxel design system, Interactive 3D previews, Custom commission intake, Printable folding guides, Lighthouse 99+

### Eagox Timer
- **Type**: Developer Focus Timer / Pomodoro
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Alshahriar-07/eagoxTimer
- **Live Demo**: https://eagox-timer.vercel.app
- **Key Features**: Web Worker timing (throttling-immune), Multiple modes, Web Audio chimes, Keyboard shortcuts, <15KB footprint

---

## Services Offered

Eagox Studio provides custom software development services:
- Modern Website / Portfolio Development
- Full-Stack Web Application (SaaS, Dashboards, APIs)
- Native Android / Mobile App Development
- Desktop Software (Electron, Tauri, C++)
- AI Pipeline & Custom Tooling (Gemini, Search Grounding, Agents)
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps

**Pricing**: Transparent BDT-based milestone pricing, starting from ~13,000 BDT
**Contact**: Order form at /order, WhatsApp, or email

---

## Technical Stack Expertise

**Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C++, SQL, Shell
**Frontend**: React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, Three.js, Canvas API
**Backend**: Node.js, Express, WebSocket Clusters, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker
**AI/ML**: Google GenAI SDK, Gemini 3.7 Flash, Search Grounding, Function Calling, Local LLMs (Ollama/vLLM)
**Mobile/Desktop**: Android/Kotlin, Electron, Tauri, UDP Hardware Bridges
**OS/Linux**: Debian, Kernel config, Systemd, Live-build
